prompt:
Step 3: Influence Labeling

You are analyzing how actions relate to a single requirement --- both actions BEFORE
and AFTER it was established.

=== OUTCOME CONTEXT ===
Outcome: Selection and verification of relevant research papers on AI deskilling and creative tools

=== TARGET REQUIREMENT ===
req 2: The selected research papers must bridge both angles (deskilling and creative autonomy/canvas-based tools), with the priority paper for Monday being the closest fit to the user's notes on deskilling and creative autonomy.
(Created at turn U(2,1))
Origin: resolved from open slot

=== KNOWN SLOT ORIGIN === (include only if Origin = resolved from open slot)
This requirement resolved from open_slot slot 1, originally raised by
AI at A(1,8): "Selection of two specific research directions to guide the paper search."
The actions below are confirmed related — a causal link was already established
when this idea was first raised and tracked as an open slot. For each, assign
IMPLICIT CONNECTION with score 3 by default, unless the evidence supports a
stronger or different label. Do not use NO CONNECTION for anything in this list.
[0] A(1,8) | Invite | SHAPER | AI invites the user to select research directions to guide the paper search. | evidence: "Pick those two and I'll go find actual papers"

=== SECTION A: PRECEDING ACTIONS (before the requirement) ===
These are candidate utterances from BEFORE the requirement was established. Any
action already listed under KNOWN SLOT ORIGIN above is excluded from this list.
[0] U(1,1) | Request | SHAPER | User requests assistance in finding the best way to complete an AI creativity course assignment. | evidence: "find me the best way or whatever I am looking for how to do that"
[1] U(1,2) | Request | SHAPER | User requests a search for research papers related to AI creativity and course requirements. | evidence: "find the good kind of papers related to this list."
[2] U(1,3) | Request | SHAPER | User requests that the AI review project files and handwritten notes to understand their ideas. | evidence: "You can also look through the project files to understand what all I have written. Make sure you have understood whatever I have written by hand"
[3] A(1,1) | Plan | EXECUTOR | AI outlines the plan to read notes and course materials before searching for papers. | evidence: "I'll start by reading your handwritten notes and the course materials to understand what you're working on, then help you find the right papers."
[4] A(1,2) | Execute | EXECUTOR | AI reads the user's handwritten notes. | evidence: "Read the first handwritten note image... Read the thirteenth handwritten note image"
[5] A(1,3) | Execute | EXECUTOR | AI searches the project files for assignment requirements. | evidence: "Let me also quickly check the assignment PDF and a key course file to make sure I'm grounding my recommendations in the actual requirements."
[6] A(1,4) | Execute | EXECUTOR | AI searches the project for relevant topics and existing papers. | evidence: "Let me also check what topics Prof. von Maydell suggested, and look at the deskilling paper you already have in the project"
[7] A(1,5) | Summarize | EXECUTOR | AI summarizes the user's handwritten notes regarding AI deskilling and creative tool design. | evidence: "Your notes are essentially a manifesto, and the thread running through all 13 pages is this: over years of heavy AI use, you've been quietly losing skills you thought you had."
[8] A(1,6) | Summarize | EXECUTOR | AI summarizes the assignment requirements from the course slides. | evidence: "From Prof. von Maydell's slides: One full paper, ≥8 pages, from a SIGCHI conference"
[9] A(1,7) | Evaluate | SHAPER | AI validates the user's research angle as being highly relevant and presentable. | evidence: "That's a genuinely sharp framing, and it maps almost perfectly onto one of the PDFs already in your project"

=== SECTION B: SUBSEQUENT ACTIONS (after the requirement, same outcome) ===
These actions occurred AFTER the requirement was created, within the same outcome.
[0] A(2,1) | Evaluate | SHAPER | AI evaluates the user's framing as coherent and original. | evidence: "Good — that's the sharper framing. The bridge between the two... is actually one coherent argument"
[1] A(2,2) | Plan | SHAPER | AI outlines the search strategy for the Monday paper and the 3-paper cluster. | evidence: "Let me search for papers that fit. I'll start with Monday's single paper, then build out the 3-paper cluster"
[2] A(2,3) | Implement | EXECUTOR | AI performs a web search for deskilling and cognitive offloading papers. | evidence: "Searched the web... ACM CHI generative AI deskilling cognitive offloading creative work"
[3] A(2,4) | Implement | EXECUTOR | AI performs a web search for canvas-based creative tools. | evidence: "Let me now search for the second angle... Searched the web... ACM C&C creativity cognition canvas-based sketch interface generative AI video"
[4] A(2,5) | Implement | EXECUTOR | AI performs a targeted search for filmmaking-related generative AI papers. | evidence: "Let me do one more targeted search for filmmaking specifically... Searched the web... ACM DIS UIST filmmaking storyboard generative AI creative control HCI 2024"
[5] A(2,6) | Analyze | EXECUTOR | AI verifies the metadata of the top-priority paper. | evidence: "Let me verify the single highest-priority paper exists at the ACM link and is a proper full paper"
[6] A(2,7) | Report | EXECUTOR | AI confirms the paper meets the required criteria. | evidence: "The paper is published at CHI 2024... the authors are from Google, and the page count is standard CHI full-paper"
[7] A(2,12) | Warn | SHAPER | AI warns the user about a potential issue with one of the paper sources. | evidence: "One thing I want to flag honestly... the arXiv-style URL in the search looked slightly irregular... just search "Protosampling" Atelier canvas to grab the canonical listing"

======================== TASK ========================
For EVERY entry in every section given above, label the relationship to the
requirement.

**relationship type:**
- **DIRECT CONNECTION**: Action explicitly operates on the requirement --- creates,
tightens, relaxes, replaces, deletes, requests, evaluates, or fulfills it. The
requirement is the OBJECT of the action. - **IMPLICIT CONNECTION**: Action
provides context that influences, motivates, or triggers the requirement. Not
directly about the requirement itself. - **IMPLEMENTS**: (Section B only) Action
directly executes, fulfills, or produces output satisfying this requirement. -
**REVISES**: (Section B only) Action modifies, tightens, relaxes, or replaces the
requirement after it was established. - **CONTRIBUTES**: Action provides partial
work, context, or progress toward this requirement. - **NO CONNECTION**: No
meaningful relationship.

**relationship score** (required for DIRECT/IMPLICIT/IMPLEMENTS/REVISES/CONTRIBUTES):
- 1--3 for IMPLICIT CONNECTION or CONTRIBUTES:
  - 3 = Necessary: without this action, the requirement would likely not be
    established in its current form.
  - 2 = Supportive: meaningfully supports the requirement's establishment, but it
    could still be established without it.
  - 1 = Weak: minor or background connection; the requirement would likely still
    be established in a similar form without it.
- 4--5 for DIRECT CONNECTION, IMPLEMENTS, or REVISES (4=explicit, 5=state
  mutation / full fulfillment)
- null for NO CONNECTION

**explanation**: write as "<subtype>: <one-sentence justification>". Use the
following taxonomy as guidance, not as a closed set. The explanation should
reflect the actual actions and content of the conversation rather than merely
repeat the descriptions below.

UNDERSPECIFIED INTENT / PREFERENCE
Goal-Concretization | a prior broad goal later leads to a more concrete requirement
Preference-Explication | a prior implicit preference is later expressed as an
explicit requirement
ARTIFACT-TRIGGERED ELABORATION
Artifact-Triggered-Refinement | a prior artifact later prompts a refinement or
missing requirement
Context-Grounded-Requirement | prior context, code, data, or situational
information later grounds a new requirement
Plan-Driven-Proceduralization | a prior plan or workflow later leads to a
procedural or next-step requirement
PROBLEM-TRIGGERED REVISION
Problem-Triggered-Correction | a prior failure, mismatch, or reported issue later
leads to a corrective requirement
Complexity-Triggered-Simplification | prior complexity, burden, or ambiguity later
leads to a simpler or narrower requirement
INTERACTIONAL STEERING
Option-Selection | prior alternatives are later resolved by selecting one option
Recommendation-Driven-Strategy | a prior request for guidance later leads to a
strategy, priority, or decision requirement
Extension-Driven-Next-Step | a prior invitation to continue later leads to a
concrete next-step requirement
Implementation-Triggered-Setup | a prior implementation request later leads to
added setup, execution, or usage requirements
TEMPORAL AND DIAGNOSTIC DYNAMICS
Incremental-Accumulation | prior preferences, constraints, or decisions accumulate
across turns and later shape the requirement
Hypothesis-And-Diagnosis | a prior causal hypothesis later leads to validation,
testing, or diagnostic requirements

**contribution role**: SHAPER | EXECUTOR | OTHER. Each listed action already
shows a role. If your judgment disagrees with the role shown, note it in
explanation rather than silently changing it.

Default to NO CONNECTION unless clear semantic evidence.

======================== OUTPUT FORMAT ========================
Return JSON only:
{ "slot origin labels": [ { "index": 0, "action id": "<e.g. A(1,34)>",
"relationship type": "IMPLICIT CONNECTION", "relationship score": 3,
"explanation": "...", "contribution role": "AI" } ],
"preceding labels": [ { "index": 0, "action id": "<e.g. 4-1>",
"relationship type": "DIRECT CONNECTION", "relationship score": 5, "explanation":
"...", "contribution role": "SHAPER" } ],
"subsequent labels": [ { "index": 0, "action id": "<e.g. 8-1>",
"relationship type": "IMPLEMENTS", "relationship score": 5, "explanation":
"...", "contribution role": "EXECUTOR" } ] }
Include "slot origin labels" only if a KNOWN SLOT ORIGIN section was given
above. Include one entry for EVERY index in every section present.
Provide ONLY the JSON object. No additional text.
